segments.text: Before the interview begins, I need to explain how your responses will be used.
Participation is voluntary, and you may skip any question without giving a reason.
With your permission, we will record audio but not video.
The research team will replace your name with a participant code.
You may withdraw your data until the analysis starts on the first of October.
